svg.title: iPhone map and job card design samples
svg.desc: Six dark glass iPhone-style layout samples for a live map on top and a real scrollable job card bottom sheet.
svg.text: Live map stays on top. Bottom job card scrolls fast. No fake phone chrome, no static card image.

g.text: Closest to the dark glass reference, but the top is still a real map.
Full real description opens inside card.
Name, apt, phone from job data
More map height, route summary pinned above a compact work card.
where I am -> job, ETA from route
First card. Opens to full description without overlap.
Real tenant data plus call action.
Action strip is sticky; details scroll underneath for speed.
Work order card, no duplicated buttons
Text wraps, never overlaps action strip.
Contact row with live call link.
Small route deck on map, larger sheet opens with drag handle.
Top map shows current location, route, ETA, distance.
Smallest scrolling distance; actions are compact and always reachable.
Remaining job details below, fast native scroll.
Maximum map visibility; card can be pulled up for full workflow/details.
Drag up for full card. Map remains usable above.
